Operation: Fill the Turkey Pen!

The Thanksgiving turkeys have escaped! Use your linear equation skills to bring them back.

🪵 · · · · · 🪵

Your mission: collect 20 turkeys!

🎯 Write a line that passes through all the turkey targets.

💨 Incorrect shot: −1 turkey escapes. Your pen cannot go below zero.

🍁 Reach 5, 10, 15 and 20 turkeys for Thanksgiving puns!

🏆 Fill the pen with 20 turkeys to unlock your own Turkey Master Certificate.

Enter your name and class hour so your teacher can track your practice.

Beginning Turkey: hit one turkey with your line. Turkey Master: hit both turkeys with the same line.

🎯 Aim your line

Find an equation that goes through both turkeys. Use slope-intercept OR point-slope form.

Remember:
Slope = change in y / change in x (Δy/Δx).
b is where you BEGIN on the y-axis.
m is how you MOVE.
Examples of accepted input:y = -1/2x + 3y - 2 = 3(x + 1)y + 4 = -2/3(x - 3)Use x and y, not x₁ or y₁, when typing.
Ready? Find the slope between the two turkeys, then write your equation!

Need a strategy reminder?

For two turkeys: find Δy/Δx, then use one turkey to write your equation. For one turkey: choose a slope and use the turkey point in point-slope form. Fire your line!
